Bench: P.Sree Sudha
The Honourable Smt. Justice P.Sree Sudha
 M.A.C.M.A.No.3120 of 2008
J U D G M E N T:

This Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act,
1988 against the Judgment and Decree dated 18.06.2007 passed in O.P.No.228 of 2006 passed by the learned Chairman, Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-Principal District Judge,
Medak, Sangareddy District.
02.

entities.text:
Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-Principal District Judge,
Medak, Sangareddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Original Petition in O.P.No.228 of 2006 was filed by appellants/petitioners claiming compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- for death of their son Nalla Venkatesham (here-in-after referred as 'deceased'), who died in the motor vehicle accident occurred on 26.11.2005.
The trial Court after considering the arguments of both sides, granted compensation only to an extent of Rs.1,00,000/-.
Aggrieved by the said Judgment, they preferred the present appeal.
03. As the present appeal is preferred only for enhancement of the compensation amount granted by the trial Court, this Court is not going into other details.

04. The learned Counsel for the appellants / petitioners contended that as on the date of accident,
the age of the deceased was 30 years and he was working as Teacher in ZP High School, Somakkapet on fixed salary of Rs.1,200/- per month for first one year and that he would have got monthly salary of Rs.10,000/- on completion of apprentice.
Therefore, requested the Court to modify the award passed by the trial Court.
05. Admittedly, he was working as Teacher in ZPHS, Somakkapet.

PW3 was examined to prove his employment and the petitioner further stated that he will get salary of Rs.10,000/- but after completion of apprentice but he worked in the school for 11 months and died in the accident.

Considering the age and occupation of the deceased, this Court finds that it is just and reasonable to take the salary of the deceased as Rs.7,000/-, as such his annual income would be Rs.84,000/-
(Rs.7000 x 12).

06. As per the guidelines of the Hon'ble Apex Court in dictum of Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation,1 if the deceased was unmarried,  of his income has to be deducted as his personal expenses.

entities.text: Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation,1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Thus, the annual income of the deceased after deducting personal expenses would come to Rs.42,000/- per annum (Rs.84,000-50% = Rs.42,000/-) and the Hon'ble Apex Court in the Nalla Ushaiah And Anr vs Shaik Qurshid And Anr on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93823227/
1 dictum of National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi2, held that the future prospects of income of the deceased shall also be included in determination of the compensation.

entities.text: Nalla Ushaiah And Anr vs Shaik Qurshid And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi2
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Thus,
considering the age of the deceased, 40% of the income i.e., Rs.16,800/- has to be added towards future prospects and thus the amount would become Rs.58,800/- (Rs.42,000 + Rs.16,800 =
Rs.58,800).

This sum if multiplied with the multiplier 17 applicable to the age of the deceased i.e.,
30, it would come to Rs.9,99,600/- (Rs.58,800 X 17 = Rs.9,99,600/-).
Thus, appellants are entitled to Rs.9,99,600/- under the head 'Loss of Dependency'.

07. Besides, appellants are also entitled for an amount of Rs.80,000/- under the head 'filial (2009)
6 SCC 121 (2017) 16 SCC 680 compensation'.

The appellants are also entitled for compensation under 'conventional heads' as prescribed in the dictum of National Insurance Company Limited Vs.
Pranay Sethi, i.e., Rs.15,000/- towards funeral charges and Rs.15,000/- towards transportation.
08.

entities.text:
National Insurance Company Limited Vs.
Pranay Sethi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Therefore, appellants/petitioners are entitled for the compensation in the following terms:
1. Loss of dependency Rs.9,99,600/-
2. Conventional heads Rs.30,000/-
3. Filial Consortium for parents @ Rs.80,000/-
Rs.40,000/- each TOTAL Rs.11,09,600/-
09.

Accordingly, this Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed by enhancing the compensation amount from Rs.1,00,000/- to Rs.11,09,600/- (Rupees Eleven Lakhs Nine Thousand Six Hundred only) with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum from the date of filing the petition till date of realization.

Respondent Nos.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation and respondent No.2/Insurance Company shall deposit the entire amount within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment.
On such deposit, both the appellants are permitted to withdraw the said amount along with interest accrued on it.
Appellants are directed to pay the deficit Court fee on the enhanced amount.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
_____________________________ JUSTICE P.SREE SUDHA Date: 21-JUL-2023 KHRM THE HONOURABLE SMT.
